Use Tier 2: change the ranking objective, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation. Replace ConvRec’s 256-negative sampled-softmax loss with balanced multi-negative binary cross-entropy while preserving the convolutional architecture. The convolutional model reached 0.4987 macro HR@10, and adding attention reduced it to 0.4913; neither result supports further architectural deepening along that branch. SASRec’s stronger Electronics result motivates testing its BCE-style supervision, although the existing comparisons do not establish that the loss caused the difference.

For each supervised sequence position, retain the tied item embeddings and jointly learned item bias, and compute softplus(-positive_score) plus the mean softplus(negative_score) over valid sampled negatives. Keep the existing 256 uniformly sampled negative IDs and mask IDs equal to that position’s positive target; normalize the negative term per position before averaging positions. This changes the competition between targets and sampled distractors into separate positive and negative discrimination, testing whether sampled-softmax coupling contributes to the plateau. Preserve prefix sampling, the 2,048-token cap, model dimensions, optimizer, schedule, and stopping rules so this is one controlled objective experiment.

Train all four category models independently from seed 42 using the unchanged supplied splits and preprocessing seed 0, with DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and trial-local artifacts. Select one checkpoint per category using fixed validation HR@10 with 200 users, 99 unique negatives, and evaluation seed 42, then recompute the macro score from the selected checkpoints and print Final Validation Score. Keep validation and working/predict.py on the identical ConvRec.predict scoring path, strictly loading exactly one checkpoint per category with all routing preserved. Let the host perform held-out inference; access no test files, and assess this hypothesis through independent host validation, particularly whether Electronics improves without sacrificing the other categories.
